carrying too many items
right now: store some of
your extra things in Kafra
Storage, and then come back.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！你现在携带的物品太多了：请将多余的东西存入卡普拉仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Hm? I'm afraid that you've
misunderstood me earlier...
You're not ready to see
me until you bring enough
of your group members with you.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
嗯？恐怕你之前误会我的意思了...
在你带够足够的队伍成员之前，
你还没有资格见我。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Ah, you've brought the
last ticket from Rospii.
Now I'm convinced that
you and your group really
work well together. Good
job on passing the trials!
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
啊，你带来了洛斯皮寄来的最后一张票据。
现在我相信你和你的队伍确实配合默契。
恭喜你们通过了试炼！

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Your group must truly
understand the value of
teamwork. And thanks to
you, I've won the bet! Er, but
what's more important is you
proving my faith in you guys.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
看来你们队伍非常懂得团队合作的价值。
而且多亏了你，我赢了赌局！呃，
但更重要的是，你们证明了我对你们的信任。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
I'm really proud of
you guys for your great
accomplishment. Here...
You deserve a real reward!
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
我为你们取得的巨大成就感到骄傲。
给...
你们值得获得真正的奖励！

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Well, I hope you like it!
If you can't use it, then
why don't you share it with
someone in your guild? Feel
free to come back if you want
to try my trials again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
嗯，希望你们喜欢！
如果你用不上，不妨分享给公会里的其他人？
如果想再次尝试我的试炼，随时欢迎回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Once again, I'd like to
thank you. I'm not sure
if we'll ever meet again,
but I'll be praying for you as
you go on your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
再次感谢你们。我不确定我们是否还会再见面，
但我会为你们在冒险途中的平安祈祷。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Hm? Why aren't your
comrades with you?
You must bring your
group members here to
proceed with these trials.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
嗯？为什么你的同志不在身边？
你必须带上你的队伍成员，
才能继续这些试炼。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Aren't you supposed to
ask one a Swordman or
Mage Class member of 
your group to bring a ticket
over to Gatan right now?
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
你不应该让队伍中一名剑士或魔法师职业的成员，
立刻把票据带给加坦吗？

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Great, you've brought
me the eighth ticket from
Lospii. Your group must
work pretty well together,
eh? It usually isn't easy to
gather people like that...
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
很好，你带来了洛斯皮寄来的第八张票据。
看来你们队伍配合得相当不错，
是吧？通常要召集这样的人并不容易...

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Please keep up the good
work until you finish all
of the trials, okay? Here's
a little reward for your
effort thus far, and the
nineth ticket for your guild.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
请继续保持这种良好的状态，直到完成所有试炼，好吗？
这是给你们目前努力的一点奖励，
以及给公会的第九张票据。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Please give that ticket
to someone in your guild
that's a Swordman or Mage
Class character, and tell
him to deliver it to Gatan.
Okay? I'll be seeing you.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
请把那张票据交给公会里一名剑士或魔法师职业的角色，
并让他把它带给加坦。
好吗？我等着你们。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Hm? Why aren't your
comrades with you?
You must bring your
group members here to
proceed with these trials.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
嗯？为什么你的同志不在身边？
你必须带上你的队伍成员，
才能继续这些试炼。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Hm? Aren't you supposed to
ask a Mage Class character
in your group to deliver
a ticket to Gatan?
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
嗯？你不应该让队伍中一名魔法师职业的角色，
把票据带给加坦吗？

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
I see that you've brought
me the fourth ticket from
Lospii. Good work, good work.
Please hang in there, and
finish all the trials we've
set before you guys, alright?
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
看来你带来了洛斯皮寄来的第四张票据。干得好，干得好。
请坚持住，
完成我们给你们设定的所有试炼，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Here's a little something
to reward you for your
efforts for now. Now, please
give this ticket to a Mage
Class character, and tell
him to bring it to Gatan.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
这是给你们目前努力的一点奖励。现在，
请把这张票据交给一名魔法师职业的角色，
并让他把它带给加坦。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Hm? Why aren't your
comrades with you?
You must bring your
group members here to
proceed with these trials.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
嗯？为什么你的同志不在身边？
你必须带上你的队伍成员，
才能继续这些试炼。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
You didn't finish what
I asked you to do, did you?
It's not time for you to
come to me, not yet.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
你并没有完成我让你做的事，对吧？
现在还不是你见我的时候，还不是时候。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
As I mentioned earlier,
I'm challenging guild
parties with missions
that will require 
cooperation between
the group members.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
正如我之前提到的，
我正在向公会队伍发起挑战，
这些任务需要队伍成员之间的合作。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
These challenges are
something of a relay
race, where we'll ask
for an item to be passed
to a member of a specific
Class to deliver for us.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
这些挑战有点像接力赛，
我们会要求将物品交给特定职业的成员，
由他们负责传递。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Of course, we, the
administrators of this
test, might add our own
little challenges here and
there to see just how
capable your group is.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
当然，作为这次测试的管理者，
我们可能会在这里或那里添加一些小挑战，
以检验你们队伍的能力。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Why don't you give it
a shot? You won't lose
anything by trying our
test. I guarantee that
you'll benefit from
our little exercise.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
何不试一试呢？尝试我们的测试不会有任何损失。
我保证你们会从这次小练习中受益。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Heh! Let's start with you!
Here, take this ticket, and
give it to a Swordman Class
member of your guild, and
ask him to bring it to Gatan.
The relay has started~
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
嘿！就从你们开始吧！
拿着，把这张票据交给公会里一名剑士职业的成员，
并让他把它带给加坦。
接力赛开始了~

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Now, since you're the
one that started the relay,
you'll have to come back
to me later on. Don't
worry, we'll let you know
once the time is right.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
既然你是发起这次接力赛的人，
之后你得回来找我。
别担心，时机成熟时我们会通知你的。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
As leader of your
Party, you should
always think of what
would be best for all
of your partners.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
作为队伍的领导者，
你应当时刻思考什么对
你的所有伙伴最有利。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
I'm sorry, but there's
nothing I can really offer
you... Unless you formed
a Party and became its
leader, there's absolutely
nothing I can do for you...
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
很抱歉，我实在没什么能给你的...
除非你组建了一支队伍并成为其首领，
否则我完全帮不了你...

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Ah, pleased to make your
acquaintance, adventurer.
I am Ledrion, a man of great
intelligence, mystery, and
most importantly, wealth.
Yes, I'm a philanthropist.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
啊，很高兴认识你，冒险者。
我是莱德里翁，一个拥有智慧、
神秘感，以及最重要的——财富的人。
没错，我是一位慈善家。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
I'm always working to make
a meaningful contribution
to all of Rune-Midgarts, which
brings me to why I am here.
There are many adventurers like you, but we have a problem.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
我一直致力于为卢恩·米德加兹
做出有意义的贡献，
这也是我出现在这里的原因。
像你们这样的冒险者有很多，
但我们面临着一个问题。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
So many adventurers have
chosen the ways of greed,
and have forgotten how to
work well together with their
colleagues. Such selfishness
sickens me to no end! Ugh!
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
太多冒险者选择了贪婪之道，
忘记了如何与同事良好合作。
这种自私让我感到恶心！呸！

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
I may not be an adventurer,
but I have the money to do
something. I am hosting
my own little challenge
to adventurers to encourage
camaraderie and teamwork.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
我虽然不是冒险者，
但我有钱去做点什么。
我正在举办一场小型挑战，
以鼓励冒险者之间的团结与团队合作。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Please, I invite you to
give it a try! Allow me to
state some of my conditions.
Firstly, you must be part of
a group of 6 or more members,
such as a Party or a Guild.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
请，我邀请你们试一试！
让我陈述一下我的条件。
首先，你必须属于一个由6名或更多
成员组成的团体，如队伍或公会。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Secondly, only the leader
of the group can begin the
first part of my challenge.
If you are not the leader,
let him know that he should
speak to me for the challenge.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
其次，只有团体的首领才能开始
我挑战的第一部分。
如果你不是首领，
请告诉他应该来找我参加挑战。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Thirdly, you must have a
Swordman Class, Mage Class,
Acolyte Class, Archer Class,
Thief Class, and Merchant
Class character to complete
the challenges you'll receive.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
第三，你必须拥有剑士、魔法师、
服事、弓箭手、盗贼和商人
职业的角色，才能完成你将收到的挑战。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Transcended characters
are good too. Fourthly, all
group members must be
at least Base Level 40.
Everything else, well,
you'll learn along the way.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
转职角色也可以。第四，所有
团体成员的基础等级必须至少为40级。
其他方面嘛，
你们会在过程中慢慢学会的。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Don't fret, I won't have you
jumping through hoops for
no reason at all. I'll provide
plenty of rewards as an
incentive for your group.
Would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
别担心，我不会让你们
无缘无故地做无用功。
我会提供丰厚的奖励作为
对你们团体的激励。
你们愿意参加吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Great! Let's see...
Well, you meet all the
requirements. It looks
like I'll win the bet! Er, let
me give you your first
set of instructions.
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
太好了！让我看看...
嗯，你们符合所有要求。
看来我赢了那个赌注！呃，
让我给你们第一组指示。

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Just--^666666*Cough!*^000000
Lemme clear my
throat for a second...

[Ledrion]
That's great! Still,
you're not ready to tackle
my little challenge until
you fulfill all of my
conditions. Come back
once you do that, alright?
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
那很好！不过，
在满足我所有条件之前，
你们还无法应对我的小挑战。
做到之后再来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Ledrion]
Really? Trust me, this
little challenge will be
worthwhile for you, and it
would bring a greater sense
of solidarity and teamwork
to Rune-Midgarts. It's win-win!
scripts.translation:
[莱德里翁]
真的吗？相信我，
这个小挑战对你们来说值得，
它将为卢恩·米德加兹带来
更强的团结感和团队合作。这是双赢！

scripts.text:
[Gatan]
Say, aren't you forgetting
something? Try to remember...
Earlier, you received some
instructions, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[加坦]
喂，你是不是忘了什么？
试着回忆一下...
刚才，你收到了一些指示，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Gatan]
Say, I don't think it's
your turn to meet up with
me. I think you need to ask a
Thief or Acolyte Class member
of your group to bring the
tenth ticket to Bafhail.
scripts.translation:
[加坦]
喂，我觉得现在不是
你该来见我的时候。
我觉得你需要让队伍中
一名盗贼或服事职业的成员
把第十张票据带给巴夫海尔。

scripts.text:
[Gatan]
Ah, very nice! Please
give this ticket to a Thief
or Acolyte Class member
of your group, and ask him
to bring it to Bafhail. Ah, and
here's a little reward for you~
scripts.translation:
[加坦]
啊，非常好！请
把这张票据交给队伍中
一名盗贼或服事职业的成员，
并让他把它带给巴夫海尔。啊，
这是给你的小奖励~

scripts.text:
[Gatan]
Alright, get that done.
I'll see you around.
scripts.translation:
[加坦]
好的，去办吧。
回头见。

Great, you gained some
levels, just like I asked.

I left it around somewhere--
and I'll give you your next set

很好，你升了几级，就像我要求的那样。

Oh, um... Is that...?
That's a ticket from
Ledrion, huh? (^666666Nuts! I've
got to work now?^000000) It's nice
to meet you. I'm Gatan.
scripts.translation:
[加坦]
哦，那个...是那个吗？
那是莱德里翁的票据，对吧？(^666666糟了，我现在得工作了？^000000)
很高兴见到你。我是加坦。

scripts.text:
[Gatan]
Well, now I've got a little
test for you. You ready?
Your objective is to gain
more levels! Let's see...
What would be fair?
scripts.translation:
[加坦]
好了，现在我要给你一个小测试。准备好了吗？
你的目标是提升等级！让我看看...
什么才算公平呢？

scripts.text:
[Gatan]
Actually, you're already
pretty strong. I don't feel
like doing much work either,
so we'll just say that you
finished my test, alright?
Just don't tell anyone!
scripts.translation:
[加坦]
其实，你已经很强了。我也不想太辛苦，
所以我们就说你通过了我的测试，好吗？
千万别告诉别人！

scripts.text:

Hold on a second...
I'm supposed to tell
you something... Give
me a minute, will you?
scripts.translation:
